note: One manifest for the whole product. Every section's acceptance test lives here. blocking=false means it is informative: a failure does not stop a release. A blocking check with unmet prerequisites may only be waived in release_waivers.json with who/when/why recorded.

milestones.name: One real task through every layer
milestones.exit: a task reaches a driver, is verified, reported, remembered and shown on the HUD

milestones.name: Contracts frozen against a working slice
milestones.exit: the M0 slice passes on two clean machines

milestones.name: Action surface complete
milestones.exit: every declared action has a driver behind it or an honest DriverUnavailable

milestones.name: Fleet and self-extension
milestones.exit: teams, Steward failover and plugin authoring verified end to end

milestones.name: Interface and voice
milestones.exit: voice-first session with live HUD wiring on real hardware

milestones.name: General availability
milestones.exit: installer on three OSes, zero coding environment, no blocking test unwaived

checks.title: One task through gate -> driver -> evidence -> memory -> bus
No banned pattern ships: no fake functionality, no test double or marker in the package
Word, Excel and CSV files written and read back with no Office installed
End-to-end Word, Excel and Outlook work through installed Office (Tier A)
checks.procedure: On a machine with Microsoft 365: create a Word document with headings and a table, save it, reopen it and confirm the content; create an Excel workbook with a formula and confirm the recalculated value; send and receive a mail in Outlook. Each step must return VERIFIED with a receipt, and closing a modified document must not silently discard it.

checks.title: Owned PTY sessions with marker completion, echo verification and L1/L2/L3 classification
Interactive programs through a session: a REPL, a pager, vim, a y/n installer, Ctrl+C, an SSH login
checks.procedure: Open a session, run python3 then 2+2 in the REPL and exit; page a long file with less and search inside it; edit and save a file in vim; answer a y/n installer; start a long job and Ctrl+C it; ssh to the test host and log in. Each must return the prompt and a receipt that names the completion reason.

checks.title: Sensor readings are plausibility-filtered, alerts fire and clear correctly, thresholds can only be tightened
Physical sensor rig: fans, rails, CPU registers and temperatures read under real load
checks.procedure: On the hardware rig, install the S2 privileged helper and confirm the Sensor Capability Report lists Super I/O fans, rails and CPU registers with their sources; apply a controlled load and confirm temperature rises, the fan curve responds, and a deliberately stuck sensor is reported as suspect rather than as a hot machine.

checks.title: Local search index: real extraction, incremental scans, verified hits, honest gaps
Retrieval accuracy on a 100,000-file corpus, and hybrid (semantic) retrieval
checks.procedure: Index the 100,000-file benchmark corpus with the quantized embedding model and measure recall@10 for a fixed query set against the lexical baseline; confirm idle indexing stays within the budget in 2.2 and that OCR and PDF extraction run where the extractors are installed. Record both numbers, including any regression.

checks.title: Schemas, versions and generated Python/TypeScript/C# bindings agree; live records validate
CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md matches the live registry; no capability is claimed without evidence
Exactly-once effects, crash reconciliation and undo-last-task
Core, LLM and action unit suites
Operations suites: supervisor, preflight, owner, verification, catalog, governor, languages
Whole suite on this machine
zyntharo doctor reports honestly: every missing driver named, none faked
M0 slice passes on a second clean machine
checks.procedure: On a machine that has never run ZYNTHARO, install, run `zyntharo doctor`, then `zyntharo run "write a file and read it back"`. Record the transcript.
checks.prerequisite_note: needs a second clean machine; set ZYNTHARO_ACCEPT_SECOND_MACHINE=1 once it exists

checks.title: Typing aborts when focus drifts, and never types into nothing
checks.procedure: Open Notepad and a second window. Ask ZYNTHARO to type a long string into Notepad, then steal focus mid-typing. Expect an abort with the wrong-window reason, no text in the other window, and a retry after re-focus. Then target a read-only field and confirm it reports failure instead of claiming success.
checks.prerequisite_note: needs a real Windows desktop with pynput/pyautogui/uiautomation installed

checks.title: Browser: tabs, chrome icons, forms, extraction with and without vision
checks.procedure: With the user's Chrome open: list tabs, switch, open and close a tab, click refresh/extensions/Lens/account/menu, fill a form, scroll, extract a table, and take the same reading with vision disabled. The two readings must carry the same information.
checks.prerequisite_note: needs a desktop browser and Playwright/CDP access

checks.title: Office: Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint round trips through COM
checks.procedure: Create, edit, save-as, export to PDF and reopen a document in each app, including an Access database and a PowerPoint deck with a chart. Confirm no document is left unsaved or locked.
checks.prerequisite_note: needs a licensed Microsoft Office install; set ZYNTHARO_ACCEPT_OFFICE_LICENSE=1

checks.title: WhatsApp: pair once, then send, receive, media, voice note and a real call
checks.procedure: Pair with a test number, list chats, search, send text/image/voice note, receive each, then place and answer a voice call using a dedicated test device. Confirm the allow-list blocks a chat that was not permitted.
checks.prerequisite_note: needs a WhatsApp test number and the Node sidecar built; set ZYNTHARO_ACCEPT_WHATSAPP_ACCOUNT=1

checks.title: Plugin authored, validated, installed, callable, removable
Supervised jobs die with the supervisor; orphan cleanup runs at startup
Owner gate: PIN required for irreversible work, voice alone refused, recovery rotates
Catalog applies only when idle, retires dead model IDs, rolls back
Locked screen, battery, audio and busy machine produce honest decisions
Risk tiers: batched harmless work, never-shortcut irreversible work
Urdu/Arabic: direction, detection, digit normalisation, OCR packs
BYOK default; hosted gateway disarmed without legal review and abuse caps
Background work yields during games/calls; user-requested work does not
Every emitted topic has a place in the interface; no bare-string topics; coverage file current
Wake word, streaming STT, TTS and barge-in on real hardware
checks.procedure: Say the wake word, interrupt the assistant mid-sentence (barge-in), and confirm the transcript in the HUD matches the audio. Repeat with Urdu or Arabic speech and confirm the language switch.
checks.prerequisite_note: needs a microphone and speakers; set ZYNTHARO_ACCEPT_AUDIO_HARDWARE=1

checks.title: HUD shows live state: particles, wires, agent graph, quota and plugin panels
checks.procedure: Run a multi-agent task and confirm wires animate only on real events, the agent graph matches the roster, the quota panel shows real headroom, and a deny/confirm shows in the panel rather than being invisible.
checks.prerequisite_note: needs a desktop session to view the webview

checks.title: Scheduled GUI task runs unattended on a dedicated machine or VM
checks.procedure: Schedule a GUI task for a time when no user is logged in but the dedicated session is unlocked, and confirm it runs; then lock the session and confirm the run defers with an honest reason instead of failing silently.
checks.prerequisite_note: needs an always-on machine or VM with an auto-login or isolated session; set ZYNTHARO_ACCEPT_DEDICATED_MACHINE=1

checks.title: Installer on a machine with no Python, Node or compiler
checks.procedure: Install from the signed package on a clean VM of each supported OS, launch, complete first-run owner setup, run one task with a bundled offline provider, then uninstall and confirm no orphaned files, services or scheduled jobs remain.
checks.prerequisite_note: needs the packaged installer plus a Windows/macOS code-signing certificate and clean VMs

checks.title: Provider terms reviewed for the chosen launch mode
checks.procedure: Record the review reference for every provider whose models ZYNTHARO calls, and for the hosted gateway specifically whether resale is permitted. BYOK needs no resale review, but still needs a privacy review.
checks.prerequisite_note: only the owner can do this; set ZYNTHARO_ACCEPT_LEGAL_REVIEW=1 once the reference is recorded

checks.title: Test accounts and licences provided (WhatsApp, Microsoft 365, Google)
checks.procedure: Provide dedicated test tenants and numbers so the browser, Office and WhatsApp checks can run without touching production data.
checks.prerequisite_note: only the owner can supply these; set ZYNTHARO_ACCEPT_TEST_TENANT=1 once created

checks.title: Nightly provider check finds retired or renamed model IDs
Suite repeated twice to catch flaky concurrency tests
checks.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
